outfits.name: Bunsen Torch
outfits.description: Though heavily debated, the more militant factions in the Senate could push through that licensed captains are allowed to equip their boarding crews with these advanced flamethrowers to break the resistance of enemy crews. However, most people would consider this weapon to be inhumane.

outfits.name: Bunsen_Torch
outfits.description: Right when the war ended, the Bunsen Torch was banned not only in the territories of the Free Worlds, but by the peace agreement also everywhere else. As to be expected, the Pirates didn't care and recognized a business opportunity. 	However, torches bought legally during the war still won't be fined because of exception rules in the corresponding paragraphs.

outfits.name: Bunsen Burner
outfits.description: Being a more sophisticated version of the flamethrower, the Bunsen Burner represents the epitome of Free Worlds creative extravagance. The fuel requirements are so significant that it comes with a pre-installed fuel pod. Nevertheless its usage became feasible only with the introduction of the catalytic ramscoop.

outfits.name: Bunsen Burner Turret
outfits.description: Being a more sophisticated version of the flamethrower, the Bunsen Burner represents the epitome of Free Worlds creative extravagance. The fuel requirements are so significant that it comes with a pre-installed fuel pod. Nevertheless its usage became feasible only with the introduction of the catalytic ramscoop. 	One of the disadvantages of the flamethrower turned out to be that it's only effective when employed on ships which are big enough to be equipped with ramscoops and several fuel pods. As such ships are often slower in turning, the Bunsen Burner comes also in a turret version with high turning rate.

missions.name: FW Bunsen Burner 1
missions.description: When you have time, report to <destination>, where Barmy Edward has another weapon he would like you to test.

values: When you have time, report to <destination>, where Barmy Edward has another weapon he would like you to test.

children.key: A message arrives from Barmy Edward of Kraz Cybernetics: "Greetings! We've prototyped a new weapon based on the same technology as the flamethrower. Stop by our lab on <destination> if you have time to help us test it."

missions.name: FW Bunsen Burner 2
missions.description: A test ship with new weaponry is in orbit around <planet>. Fight and disable it (but do not destroy it!) and then land to give Dr. Cardona feedback on its performance.

values: A test ship with new weaponry is in orbit around <planet>. Fight and disable it (but do not destroy it!) and then land to give Dr. Cardona feedback on its performance.

children.key: You received a message recently from Barmy Edward, asking you to stop by the Kraz Cybernetics facility to help test a new weapon. Do you want to visit them now?

The Kraz Cybernetics receptionist points you in a familiar direction, towards the hangar where Barmy Edward does his work. You do not find him there; instead, you are greeted by one of his colleagues: "Good afternoon. Captain <last>, is it? I'm Dr. Chris Cardona. I work with Mr. Edward on the occasional project, including this latest prototype. We had some - uh - technical difficulties with the fuel injection component, and Mr. Edward is on temporary medical leave. Not to worry, he left me with clear instructions regarding your assignment."
He seems unfazed by this state of affairs.

Just as before, you are to engage our test ship in combat in orbit above <planet> and attempt to disable it without causing permanent damage to its hull. In this case, it is a salvaged Falcon, the Red Hammer."

"Yes, the fuel injector came loose and doused the hangar with hyperspace fuel. It didn't ignite, but Mr. Edward inhaled enough of the vapours to put him out of action for a few weeks. Thankfully, the lab was not damaged, and production of test units is still on schedule."
"Sorry, I'd rather not end up like Edward. I don't want to be involved."

You return to Kraz Cybernetics to deliver your report to Dr. Cardona. As you approach the hangar, he steps outside, removes a respirator and pair of safety goggles from his face, and rushes forward to meet you.
"Captain <last>, you're back so soon? Come, let us discuss your findings in my office, where the air is - uh - better conditioned. It's humid out here, no?"
You follow him to his office, away from the hangar, and away from an unusual smell which has begun to fill the air.
"I was able to neutralize it without much effort."
He glances at the figures displayed on his monitor.
"Yes, the data we've collected remotely seem to meet our expectations."
"I see. Surely that speaks more to the effectiveness of your ship's cooling system than to any deficiency in the prototype."

"You should be able to find production models at our distributors within one to two months. On behalf of Kraz Cybernetics, I thank you for your assistance. Mr. Edward will be pleased to hear of our success." You bid Dr. Cardona farewell, and return to your ship.
